Name: Birdie Hut Interior
Author: zilchaz
Description:
After I finish redesigning Birdie Hut in my [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7872]Cozy Hut House[/url]﻿ mod. I think it'd be nice if we can enter her hut.

[spoiler][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/7872/7872-1650278263-1320601964.png[/img][/spoiler]

So here we are.

This mod only adds a location for Birdie Hut and does not touch her schedule [s](it seems she didn't have one since she's not a full NPC?), so Birdie will never sleep in her hut...[/s]

Recommended to use this mod with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/78813038]tikamin557[/url]'s [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/28690]Complement Birdie[/url] as they make Birdie into an interactable NPC.

.

You can enter her hut only [b][u]after[/u][/b] you finish her questline.

.
